I guess you've noticed the stop time in both records. This record was played probably 10 years or 12 years before Armstrong's record was played. I'll let you know how far the colored man has come.

Playing a tiger rag. This is Dixonland Jubilee by Kit Ory. This is only about a year old. Between this and the one that I'll play that was played almost 42 years ago, 41 years ago, you'll see the difference. That's what these white men call good music. Some of these tribes should go back in Africa and live over there and find out about the Negro place over there. This man is coming Louis Armstrong. That's Armstrong.
